mentions.name: Open-source Shopify alternative
mentions.description: Open-source e-commerce platform built as a Shopify alternative, shipped at the end of last year as part of a planned open-source SaaS suite covering every business vertical.
mentions.source_excerpt: We're actually building an opensource SaaS for every vertical. We shipped our Shopify alternative end of last year and after restaurant, we have hotels, grocery, and gyms next.
